behavior.R06: A same-member profile snapshot survives normal Points blur/refocus while its background refresh runs; busy/loading stays hidden for that refresh. Sign-out/account change clears the profile and invalidates generation/session ownership; deferred member A data cannot replace member B.
behavior.R07: Server projects active daily_point_entitlements by task_date; opening/cumulative fields are optional/additive, carry-in uses the same active predicate as lifetime earned, redemptions leave earned history unchanged, and backfill/revoke move cumulative values from the affected task date. Trend is default; calendar remains selectable, with week/month/year/all and period navigation preserved. Future-dated awards are not counted as happened calendar days or included as future curve points.
behavior.R08: The main goal area is an accessible Pressable that opens the existing rewards picker, including when its sole active reward is already selected. Active options remain selectable; target changes use the existing setTarget path and do not change wallet balance.

compatibility.oldClientNewServer: Additive unknown JSON fields: the base client parser validates known required fields and projects them without rejecting unrecognized keys. No old-client change is required.
compatibility.newClientOldServer: New chart fields are optional. The client accepts old payloads; UI does not infer cumulative values and displays a clear unavailable state while preserving the calendar.
compatibility.backendDependency: server/gamification.ts now emits the chart fields. The pinned live backend has not changed; release/integration must carry this server commit through a separate pinned release worktree and approved cutover before the cumulative curve is available from the live API.
